name: Ōma (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Ōma town emblem in white: a broken ring with four spokes around a central ring.
history: Municipal flag of Ōma, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 August 1966; the emblem dates from 25 August 1966.

features.role: Ōma town emblem — a broken ring with four spokes around a central ring
